rationale: The agent did authenticate the user via name/ZIP lookup and retrieved user/order details. However, it appears to have executed an exchange (exchange_delivered_order_items) without any explicit user confirmation shown, violating the requirement to confirm every order-changing action. The user requested exchanges for both a water bottle and a desk lamp, with preferences; the agent seems to have exchanged only one item (single item_id in the write call) and the closing message references only the desk lamp. There is no evidence the agent asked for confirmation (which would have triggered the user’s instruction to only exchange the lamp), nor that the replacements matched the stated preferences. The final message provides no concrete details about the exchange outcome, costs, return instructions, or timelines. These issues fail the pass bar.
